# hpe_morpheus_network_firewall_rule (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_firewall_rule" "example" {
  id                     = 99
  network_integration_id = 1
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_firewall_rule" "example" {
  name                   = "Example name"
  network_integration_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_integration_id` (Number) The ID of the network integration that the firewall rule belongs to

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the network firewall rule
- `name` (String) The name of the network firewall rule

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes Set) The applications associated with the firewall rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `applied_targets` (Dynamic) The applied targets of the firewall rule
- `config` (Dynamic) Additional configuration for the firewall rule
- `destination_type` (String) The destination type of the firewall rule
- `destinations` (Attributes Set) The destination objects of the firewall rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))
- `direction` (String) The direction of the firewall rule (e.g. ingress, egress)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the firewall rule is enabled
- `group_name` (String) The name of the firewall rule group
- `policy` (String) The policy action of the firewall rule (e.g. accept, deny)
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the firewall rule
- `profiles` (Attributes Set) The profiles associated with the firewall rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))
- `rule_group` (Attributes) The rule group associated with the firewall rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_group))
- `scopes` (Attributes Set) The scopes associated with the firewall rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scopes))
- `source_type` (String) The source type of the firewall rule
- `sources` (Attributes Set) The source objects of the firewall rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources))
